title: Lumped two-ports through their network matrices: a shunt resistor's Z, a series inductor's ABCD and its equivalent circuit, an L-pad in mixed mode
source: D. M. Pozar, Microwave Engineering, 4th ed., Wiley 2012, Table 4.1 (a shunt admittance's Z: every entry 1/Y; a series impedance's ABCD [1 Z; 0 1]) and Table 4.2 (S from ABCD); D. E. Bockelman, W. R. Eisenstadt, IEEE Trans. MTT 43(7), 1995: one pair's mixed-mode S, Sdd = (S11 − S12 − S21 + S22)/2. The L-pad (50 Ω in series, 50 Ω shunt) on 50 Ω: from its ABCD [2, 50; 0.02, 1], Δ = 5, S11 = 0.2 (75 Ω seen at port 1), S21 = S12 = 0.4, S22 = −0.2, so Sdd = −0.4
